name: Micropod — operational icon set

geometry.strokeUnits: SVG user units at a 24px render size

provenance: Original project-local geometry authored for Micropod; not extracted from an icon library.

validation.visualRendering: AppKit SVG decoding and PNG rendering verified and visually reviewed for all 24 icons at 28px, in both light and dark; small operational sizes and native app integration remain untested.
validation.sfSymbolNames: proposed; unverified against SF Symbols or minimum macOS version

icons.label: Workloads
icons.semantics: All running and stopped containers and microVMs.

icons.label: Container
icons.semantics: A single container workload.

icons.label: MicroVM
icons.semantics: A lightweight virtual machine and its guest runtime.

icons.label: Stack
icons.semantics: A project or compose group containing several workloads.

icons.label: Images
icons.semantics: Local or registry container images and their layers.

icons.label: Cache
icons.semantics: Shared build and runtime cache inventory.

icons.label: Cache hit
icons.semantics: A build step reused a compatible cached result.

icons.label: Warm cache
icons.semantics: Frequently used layers are retained or preloaded.

icons.label: Pinned cache
icons.semantics: Keep selected cache data beyond automatic eviction.

icons.label: Clean cache
icons.semantics: Review and reclaim eligible cached data.

icons.label: CPU
icons.semantics: Host or guest processor utilization and allocation.

icons.label: Memory
icons.semantics: Used, available, and assigned RAM.

icons.label: Storage
icons.semantics: Disk utilization, volumes, and virtual disks.

icons.label: Network
icons.semantics: Workload networking, ports, and transfer activity.

icons.label: Logs
icons.semantics: Timestamped workload output and events.

icons.label: Terminal
icons.semantics: Open an interactive shell inside a workload.

icons.label: Start
icons.semantics: Start a stopped workload or resume a suspended guest.

icons.label: Stop
icons.semantics: Gracefully stop a running workload.

icons.label: Restart
icons.semantics: Stop and restart a workload with its existing configuration.

icons.label: Search
icons.semantics: Filter the current list or invoke global workload search.

icons.label: Settings
icons.semantics: Configure host resources and Micropod preferences.

icons.label: Open externally
icons.semantics: Open a linked endpoint, registry, or documentation in its associated app.

icons.label: Download
icons.semantics: Pull an image or download an exported artifact.

icons.label: Activity
icons.semantics: Live utilization, workload events, or transfer activity.
